name: SwarmMojo
description: Full-fledged local-first AI agent harness combining ROMS (RAG, OKF, MCP, Skills), Swarm Mojo (Aeon specialist reviews, workflow rehearsal, mSGL), and PolyHarness (universal configuration & deterministic guardrails).
guidelines: Always run tests before completing changes (pytest)
Write concise commit messages following Conventional Commits
Never commit API keys, tokens, or plain secrets
Keep specialist reviews and decision maker checks bounded and reproducible

rules.name: roms-core
rules.description: Guidelines for ROMS engine, decision maker, and broker components
guidelines: Follow explicit typing and avoid untracked mutations
Keep decision boundaries deterministic and bounded
Use safe path validation for all file access

rules.name: aeon-swarm
rules.description: Guidelines for Aeon specialist reviews and workflow rehearsal
guidelines: Ensure workflow rehearsals via TriggerTangle remain offline and advisory
Maintain explicit user approvals before mutating workspace state
Keep SGLang and mSGL inference adapters optional and decoupled

rules.name: polyharness-compiler
rules.description: Guidelines for the PolyHarness transpiler engine
guidelines: Maintain zero external runtime dependencies in ESM
Ensure all target formats (Claude, Cursor, DSH, AGENTS) remain synchronized

skills.name: swarm-rehearsal
skills.description: Rehearse automation workflows and causal loops
skills.prompt: Rehearse workflows before execution and verify trigger boundaries

skills.name: polyharness-builder
skills.description: Transpiles agent harness configs to all target formats
skills.prompt: Compile harness.config.json into CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, dsh.config.json, .cursorrules
